hook: Your health history doesn't live in one place.
caption: Your health history doesn't live in one place. PDFs, notes, measurements, daily entries, all waiting to become connected context. HealthGraph turns your scattered records into a timeline you can browse, ask, and open day by day. Explore HealthGraph at healthgraph.shop #HealthGraph #PersonalHealth #HealthHistory #HealthTech #DigitalHealth #HealthDiary #SelfTracking #HealthData #Wellness #HealthJournal

lines.text: Your health history doesn't live in one place.
lines.beat: ACT1: fragmented objects drift apart in dark space as floating cards: PDF, NOTE, MEDICATION, MEASUREMENT, PHOTO, DAILY ENTRY.

lines.text: And the pieces don't always make sense when they're separated.
lines.beat: ACT1: the floating pieces hold still with no lines between them, separate and unlinked.

lines.text: A report here, a note there, a measurement somewhere else entirely.
lines.beat: ACT1: three object groups pan past in slow parallax: a PDF report, a handwritten note, a measurement card.

lines.text: Meds, photos, daily entries, each one floating alone, disconnected from the rest.
lines.beat: ACT1: the full constellation of disconnected entries rotates slowly, every card isolated.

lines.text: None of it connects to the other, and nobody keeps the whole.
lines.beat: ACT1: slow push-in on the empty space between the pieces, emphasizing what is missing.

lines.text: You remember the result, but not the day you uploaded it.
lines.beat: ACT2: half-remembered calendar dates dissolve over the floating fragments.

lines.text: What you took, when you took it, what has changed since.
lines.beat: ACT2: three floating question fragments surface: what happened, what you took, what changed.

lines.text: So the past only comes back in fragments, in dates you half remember.
lines.beat: ACT2: the fragments drift out of focus into soft blur, memory visibly slipping away.

lines.text: HealthGraph starts with a different idea about how this could work.
lines.beat: ACT2: the blur clears and a single glowing line begins to draw where the pieces were.

lines.text: A document becomes a record. A moment becomes a point on a timeline.
lines.beat: ACT3: a PDF document card transforms into a structured record card, then docks onto a growing timeline.

lines.text: A measurement finds its day. A medication finds its history.
lines.beat: ACT3: a measurement card snaps to its date and a medication card links to its earlier entries.

lines.text: Entries that never spoke to each other now quietly connect.
lines.beat: ACT3: graph edges draw between nodes in teal, disconnected objects now sharing lines.

lines.text: Each keeps its date, its source, and its place in the story.
lines.beat: ACT3: camera pulls back to show every node holding its date label and source type.

lines.text: Draw it out, and your whole history starts to look like a graph.
lines.beat: ACT3: the constellation resolves into a full graph and the HEALTHGRAPH wordmark reveals.

lines.text: Open the app, and today is already here, with your patterns by week, by year.
lines.beat: ACT4: home-dashboard.jpg fills the frame: Today Done 100% and Your patterns Week, Month, Year.

lines.text: The health areas open one after another, each carrying its own history.
lines.beat: ACT4: explore-grid.png tiles cascade open as the health areas pan into view.

lines.text: Records, documents, medications, measurements, flowing together instead of stacked in separate apps.
lines.beat: ACT4: records-upload.jpg, daily-log.jpg and medication rows flow side by side in a continuous montage.

lines.text: Not a feature list. A flow, the way your health actually moves day to day.
lines.beat: ACT4: the montage resolves into health-graph.jpg, every element moving as one flow.

lines.text: The timeline runs underneath it all, quiet and continuous.
lines.beat: ACT4: the health-graph timeline scrolls slowly beneath the nodes, 12 nodes, 22 connections.

lines.text: Every day becomes a report. Not a card, a document.
lines.beat: ACT5: the health-graph timeline compresses downward into a single day band.

lines.text: The whole timeline folds down into one full, ordinary day.
lines.beat: ACT5: daily-log.jpg opens: Mood Very good, Sleep 7h, recent history events listed.

lines.text: Pulse, sleep, meals, mood, all logged across the hours of the day.
lines.beat: ACT5: daily-report.jpg stats glide across: pulse, meals, sleep and mood entries of the day.

lines.text: Select a day, and the paper report rises and opens.
lines.beat: ACT5: the selected cream paper report rises from the stack and opens, 3 OCT Today.

lines.text: An archive of days, your own history, one page at a time.
lines.beat: ACT5: the opened paper report settles like a page in an archive, more days waiting behind it.

lines.text: Ask your records: when did I upload my blood report?
lines.beat: ACT6: ai-chat.jpg, the question types into the Ask about your health input.

lines.text: The answer comes back, and the timeline moves to that day.
lines.beat: ACT6: the answer arrives and the health-graph timeline navigates to the matching date node.

lines.text: The daily report opens, and the record is right there, highlighted.
lines.beat: ACT6: the daily report opens beside the answer and the matching record is highlighted in teal.

lines.text: The answer arrives with the record behind it, not just text.
lines.beat: ACT6: split view holds: answer text on the left, the full record behind it on the right.

lines.text: Evidence you can open, verify, and return to whenever you need it.
lines.beat: ACT6: the record card lifts forward as a tappable document, evidence held up to the light.

lines.text: A pulse check: place your fingertip on the sensor, just sixty seconds.
lines.beat: ACT7: pulse-measurement.jpg, fingertip on the sensor, the green trace drawing in.

lines.text: Sixty seven beats per minute, saved right into the day around it.
lines.beat: ACT7: Measurement complete, 67 BPM FINGERTIP, the value saves into the day.

lines.text: Meds, symptoms, sleep, nutrition, all connected around that one moment.
lines.beat: ACT7: edges draw from the measurement node to medication, sleep, nutrition and symptom nodes.

lines.text: A measurement becomes context the moment it is saved to the day.
lines.beat: ACT7: the measurement node pulses once as it lands in the health-graph, context complete.

lines.text: Each reading joins the day it happened, with everything else logged.
lines.beat: ACT7: the timeline scrolls to that day and every logged entry gathers around the reading.

lines.text: You can also speak out loud, and your history listens back.
lines.beat: ACT8: the red voice pulse FAB breathes as a waveform rises over the dark UI.

lines.text: A quick voice check in, answered from your own records.
lines.beat: ACT8: a short voice exchange plays on the ai-chat screen, the answer references your own records.

lines.text: Every day connected, and every record in context.
lines.beat: ACT9: the full health-graph rotates gently, every node lit, calm and complete.

lines.text: Your health, connected.
lines.beat: ACT9: wordmark hold on dark: Your health, connected.

lines.text: Explore HealthGraph at healthgraph dot shop.
lines.beat: ACT9: end card with the HEALTHGRAPH mark and healthgraph.shop, quiet fade.
